# profiles_asset.c is generated by tools/gen_profiles_asset.py, wired in as a
# PlatformIO pre-build hook. See the UI component for why generation happens
# there rather than in a CMake rule.

idf_component_register(
    SRCS "src/Profiles.cpp" "src/profiles_asset.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
)

target_compile_features(${COMPONENT_LIB} PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
